title: 第2295章 误打误撞第2294章 伪道元身傀古目
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【命运有时候得信，虽然当真正不利于你的命运时你会不认命。
但当事情可能会给你带来好处，其实你并不抗拒，能够虚心接受。
而从这个出发点来看，你心中最终有两个巨大的疑问出现。
“会是悖论即将要开始的真铸……还是这伪道元身傀知道一件与悖论相当恰合的真至宝？”
在你看来，如果说墨骨的人生的重要节点，那么通向帝兵的真铸无疑是重中之重。
你该准备的已经为墨骨准备了，现在从它对你的态度也能看出，早就不比凤凰元灵差多少，对你拥护到了极致。
但你不解的是，一个未曾相识的家伙又怎么跟一件至宝产生这么大的联系。
【问题不一定就要有答案，因为事实可能谁都想不到，也比你想象中的要扯淡。
也是在你沉思这一件事的时候，悖论元灵的表情发生了变化。
他见到与古目待了一会的你，乃至是一旁抓紧时间继续恢复的苍灵，都开始与古目有了命运联系。
你是从弱到强，而苍灵则是从无到有，再到强命运联系。
凭空出现的命运牵连，就算是燊图那种参透了命运法则道纹的前宿主，其巅峰时也做不到。
至少对现在修为境界的你，做不到这一点。
悖论如果有实体，现在真应该汗流浃背……但这不影响悖论的反应，它急迫的将事情告诉给了你，并确认了想要做到这一点的难处。
【你也总算知道，为什么一开始悖论会看不出与古目交手的墨骨，会与古目有强命运联系。
感情这事情与你现在一样，这不是从一开始就有，而是在见到人之后才新创建的。
虽然很荒唐，但古目对你无疑有更大的研究价值。
因为在你身边不仅有着悖论这一件命运至宝，还有另一位参透命运与轮回双法则道纹的萧晴。
挖出古目的秘密，这对萧晴必是一个巨大的机缘！
不到一个时辰的时间，你摒弃了古目能开口后，说出的所有话。
因为你确定，哪怕是为了活命，这家伙说的话也没有一句是真的。
但这不重要，你已经知道为什么她会与你、与墨骨和苍灵都有联系。
【在古目身上的千万零件中，有一个芥子微小的印记。
这印记极不起眼，否则也不至于你在前几次看向古目时都没关注到。
近距离接触下，又或者是古目自己暗中做了什么，这印记由暗转明。
而恰好这印记你曾在晨媛给的诸多书中有见过，这是她队伍中一个叫做“晨宽”
小伙，所属一脉传承的伪道生元契印记。
这所代表的意义很大，至少你不需要急着杀死古目，眼前这个人在见到晨宽后，直接便是半个自己人。
【提到晨宽，便不得不说你之前想要拆了古目做材料，便是你有底气能用得着。
content_en:
[You can sometimes believe in fate, although you will not accept it when it is really not in your favor.
But when something may bring you benefits, you don't resist it and can accept it humbly.
From this starting point, you will eventually have two huge questions in your mind.
"Is it the true cast that is about to start the paradox...or does this pseudo Dao Yuan body puppet know a true treasure that is quite suitable for the paradox?"
In your opinion, if there is an important node in Mo Gu's life, then the true casting leading to the Imperial Armament is undoubtedly the top priority.
What you should prepare has been prepared for Mo Gu, and now it can be seen from its attitude towards you that it has long been no worse than Phoenix Yuanling and supports you to the extreme.
But what you don't understand is how a guy you've never met has such a big connection with a treasure.
[The question does not necessarily have an answer, because the truth may be unexpected by no one, and it may be more nonsense than you think.
It was also when you were meditating on this matter that Paradox Yuanling's expression changed.
When he saw you who had been with Gumu for a while, and even Cangling who was seizing the time to continue recovering, he began to have a destiny connection with Gumu.
You go from weak to strong, while Cangling goes from scratch to strong destiny connection.
Even a former host like Shen Tu, who had understood the laws of fate, could not do it when he was at his peak.
At least you can't do this with your current cultivation level.
If Paradox had an entity, it would really be sweating right now... But this does not affect Paradox's reaction. It tells you things urgently and confirms the difficulty of doing this.
[You finally know why Paradox couldn’t see that Mo Gu, who fought against Gu Mu, had a strong destiny connection with Gu Mu at the beginning.
Emotions are the same as you are now. They are not there from the beginning, but are newly created after meeting people.
Although it is ridiculous, Gumu undoubtedly has greater research value for you.
Because beside you is not only Paradox, the treasure of destiny, but also Xiao Qing, who understands the dual laws of destiny and reincarnation.
Digging out the secret of the ancient eye must be a huge opportunity for Xiao Qing!
…
In less than an hour, you abandoned all the words Gumu had said since he was able to speak.
Because you are sure that even if it is to survive, nothing this guy says is true.
But that doesn't matter, you already know why she is connected to you, to Inkbone, and to Cangling.
[Among the millions of parts on Gu Mu’s body, there is a tiny mark of a mustard seed.
This mark is extremely inconspicuous, otherwise you wouldn’t have noticed it the first few times you looked at Gu Mu.
Under close contact, or perhaps Gu Mu himself did something secretly, the mark turned from dark to bright.
And it just so happens that you have seen this mark in many books given by Chen Yuan. It is from a person in her team called "Chen Kuan"
Young man, the imprint of the Pseudo-Daosheng Yuan Deed of the same lineage.
This means a lot. At least you don't need to rush to kill Gu Mu. The person in front of you will become half of you after meeting Chen Kuan.
[When it comes to Chen Kuan, I have to say that you wanted to dismantle the ancient objects to make materials before, so you can use them if you have the confidence.
